subject: one low curling porcelain wave
art_direction: 奶白瓷面在底部卷出一段低浪，青灰阴影和暖金薄光让结构清楚。
visible_description: 奶白瓷面在底部卷出一段低浪，青灰阴影和暖金薄光让结构清楚。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Shape one low curling wave from warm-white porcelain along the bottom edge. Its broad inner curve holds a soft blue-gray shadow, while a thin pale-gold reflection traces the rim. Show satin glaze and slight surface irregularity without decorative patterns. A smooth light neutral field above emphasizes pure stillness, letting the sculpted curve feel both minimal and materially rich. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
